import ast
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\ccr.py')
tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'CCR')
method = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'stats')
namespace = {'_STORAGE_ERRORS': (sqlite3.Error,)}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
stats = namespace['stats']
store = MagicMock()
store._scope_key = 'test-scope'
store._db_path = Path('test.db')
store.shared = False
store.last_gc = None
conn = store._connect.return_value.__enter__.return_value
conn.execute.return_value.fetchone.side_effect = [(2, 100, 50, 3), (1, 1)]
default = stats(store)
assert 'evicted_records' not in default
assert conn.execute.call_count == 2
conn.reset_mock()
conn.execute.return_value.fetchone.side_effect = [(2, 100, 50, 3), (1, 1), (7,)]
assert stats(store, include_evictions=True) == {**default, 'evicted_records': 7}
conn.execute.assert_called_with('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ccr_evictions WHERE scope=?', ('test-scope',))
store._connect.side_effect = sqlite3.OperationalError('unreadable')
fallback = stats(store)
assert 'evicted_records' not in fallback
assert stats(store, include_evictions=True) == {**fallback, 'evicted_records': 0}
try:
    stats(store, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('parameter must be keyword-only')
print('Focused stats checks passed')
